content.title: How to Start Selling Digital Products with Crypto Payments

content.text: What This Actually Is and Why It Matters: Crypto payment

A crypto payment gateway serves as an infrastructure layer that allows digital creators to accept payments in cryptocurrencies. Unlike traditional payment processors that impose steep transaction fees, such as Gumroad's 10%, crypto gateways like NOWPayments charge only 0.5%. This significant cost reduction can result in substantial savings for creators, allowing them to retain more of their earnings while providing flexibility to customers who prefer using digital currencies.
How the Architecture Works Under the Hood

The architecture of a crypto payment gateway integrates various tools and platforms to create a seamless sales experience. At its core, it typically leverages a combination of frontend hosting solutions like GitHub Pages or Cloudflare Pages, backend logic through Cloudflare Workers or Google Apps Script, and data storage with Supabase or Google Sheets. Together, these components ensure that transactions are processed quickly and securely, delivering digital products automatically upon payment confirmation.
Who This Is Built For and Why

This infrastructure is specifically designed for digital creators in regions where conventional payment platforms are either unavailable or impose crippling fees. By utilizing crypto payment gateways, these creators can circumvent traditional financial barriers and gain access to a global market. Whether selling ebooks, courses, or unique digital assets, they can operate independently without reliance on third-party platforms, thus owning their entire sales process and customer data.
Crypto payment gateways offer significantly lower fees than traditional platforms.
The Components That Make It Work Together

The key components of a crypto payment gateway include hosting services, payment processors, backend logic, and storage solutions. GitHub Pages or Cloudflare Pages serve as the hosting layer, while NOWPayments handles cryptocurrency transactions. Cloudflare Workers or Google Apps Script manage the backend processes, and data is securely stored in Supabase or Google Sheets. Together, these components form a cohesive system that allows for efficient product delivery and payment processing.
How to Use This Knowledge to Deploy Today

To start deploying a crypto payment gateway, first, select a hosting solution such as GitHub Pages. Next, configure backend logic using Google Apps Script or Cloudflare Workers. Set up a NOWPayments account to handle cryptocurrency transactions, and create a product catalog stored in Supabase or Google Sheets. Finally, test the complete workflow to ensure seamless product delivery and payment verification. For a comprehensive solution, explore the Complete Builder Kit ($197) available at https://coremerch.github.io/products.html.
How do I sell an ebook online without PayPal or Stripe?

To sell an ebook online without PayPal or Stripe, consider using a crypto payment gateway. These gateways allow you to accept cryptocurrency payments directly, bypassing traditional platforms altogether. Solutions like NOWPayments enable instant payment processing with minimal fees, making it feasible to sell digital products globally without worrying about platform restrictions.
You retain complete ownership of your sales infrastructure without ongoing costs.
Related: How Creators Like You Are Building Sovereign Stores

If you are looking for additional resources on setting up a sovereign digital store, the Complete Builder Kit ($197) contains everything you need to build, deploy, and scale your infrastructure. This kit provides all six blueprints and seven templates necessary for establishing a fully functional online store that leverages crypto payments. Explore more at https://coremerch.github.io/products.html.
Your Deployment Checklist

Prepare your product files in delivery-ready format — PDF for ebooks, ZIP archives for multi-file products, exported files for Notion templates, OTF and TTF archives for font families. Set your prices in USD and let NOWPayments handle the crypto equivalent calculation automatically at transaction time. Deploy your stack and configure the product list with file paths, USD prices, and delivery settings. Configure your storefront with product pages and checkout flow. Test the checkout on both desktop and mobile — confirm QR codes generate correctly and live price feeds display accurately. Complete a real mainnet test transaction and confirm the delivery email arrives with a working download link. Check your order database and confirm the test transaction appears with all correct fields.
Frequently Asked Questions
How do I sell an ebook online without PayPal or Stripe?

Utilize a crypto payment gateway to accept payments directly in cryptocurrency. Platforms like NOWPayments offer low fees and no KYC requirements, allowing you to sell ebooks without relying on traditional payment processors.
What is the best way to sell digital downloads without platform fees?

The best way is to establish your own sales infrastructure using a combination of hosting, backend services, and a crypto payment gateway. This eliminates platform fees and gives you complete control over your sales process.
Can I sell templates and fonts without using Gumroad or Payhip?
Yes, you can sell templates and fonts using a crypto payment gateway. This allows you to accept payments without relying on platforms like Gumroad or Payhip, giving you higher profit margins.
What are the advantages of using crypto payment gateways?

Crypto payment gateways offer lower transaction fees, faster payment processing, and no dependency on traditional banking systems. This is particularly beneficial for digital creators in regions facing financial restrictions.
How do I ensure secure delivery of my digital products?

To ensure secure delivery, utilize backend scripts to automate product distribution. Pair this with reliable storage solutions to manage your digital files, ensuring customers receive their purchases immediately upon payment.
Deploying your own stack allows for greater flexibility and autonomy in selling digital products.
